3. Plaintiffs averments leading to the suit are that, the suit land along with other lands belonged to four brothers, namely Meher Ali, Ala Meah, Abdul Aziz and Abdul Hakim, Accordingly, they were in possession. The RS Khatian was also prepared in their favour ihowing 4 annas share against each of them. Plaintiff is the daughter of Khalilur Rahman who was a son of said Meher Ali. Plaintiff has filed the suit for declaration of her title in eight annas share in the suit land as described in the schedule of the plaint. Ala Miah mortgaged his 4 annas share on 4-11-47 with one Abul Khair, Khalilur Rahman later on redeemed the mortgage and got the said land freed. Khalilur Rahman thus became owner to the extent of 4 annas of the lands after death of his father in the suit holding of said 4 brothers. 

 4. Subsequently, Khalilur Rahman gifted his entire 4 annas share to the plaintiff who is his daughter. Defendants 1-4 contested the suit by filing written statement. They admit that the land of the suit Khatian originally belonged to the aforesaid four brothers. But during their life time and after their death many inter transfers have commenced. As a result, according to the defendants the plaintiff is not entitled to get 0.28 decimals of land as claimed specific case of the defendants is that since the suit land in party ejmali land without prayer for partition no decree can be passed in respect of 0.28 acres land for declaration of title.
